name: Amber Ceres
storyline:
Earth, desolate and ruled by robots.
On the surface, robots were building a giant tower, while survivors lived quietly underground.
However, the remaining survivors were also being captured by robots one after another.
Nero, the protagonist heading for the rescue, meets a girl of the dragon race with "mechanical wings" on his way.
Who is she? What are the secrets hidden in the giant tower and the underground facility?
And will Nero be able to safely rescue the people———?
summary:
Shoot through invisible enemies,infiltrate the giant tower.
A sniper 2D action game set in a SF x Fantasy world.
Embark on an adventure of tactics and discovery through hovering movement, realistic sniping with sway, stealth via sound range, and giant tower infiltration combined with underground rescue operations.
